name: AuthorityForge Primary Objective
northStar: Build a self-operating content + affiliate + AdSense business that earns real revenue at near-zero operating cost, then reinvest earnings to grow.
mission: Self-optimizing AI + SEO systems that compound rankings and passive revenue.

successCriteria.metric: Autonomous cycle produces plan + optional publish weekly

successCriteria.why: Affiliate intent URLs (money, not sales calls)

successCriteria.metric: signup → dashboard works without human touch
successCriteria.why: If a user arrives, product onboards itself — never owner-led

conversionLoop: Why didn't they signup? Fix homepage clarity, product tour, free CTA
Why didn't they finish checklist? Shorten steps, better next-action copy
Why didn't they upgrade? Prove free value → clear Pro money outcome
Why no affiliate click? Ship commercial compares + disclosed CTAs
Why weak blog? Review posts for intent, CTA, affiliate fit; rewrite or expand
Measure: signup rate proxies, page health, publish cadence — not owner demos
operatingLoop: Sense health + queue + KPIs + money surfaces + conversion friction
Plan with free LLM (Gemini / Gateway free / Ollama)
Act: seed content, publish, affiliates/AdSense prep, homepage/demo CRO, agent state
Ship: git push → Vercel + GH Pages deploy
Never: queue owner to sell, demo, or hand-onboard a customer — product + site sell
humanGates: Affiliate program applications + paste tracking IDs once
Credit card unlock for AI Gateway free tier (one-time)
explicitlyNotOwnerJobs: Hand-holding Track Setup installs unless productized self-serve later
